items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know this fellow they call Dude? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, he played piano.

ctx.x: I think we know his dad is dead. But he died there. He died there, you know.
Reminds me of... Did you know this fellow they call Dude? His real name is Frank Amaker. Dude? He lives at 520 Burgundy now.
Oh yeah, he played piano. Played piano.
